title: Qman DirectPath target test RunnerManifest
description: Closed signed descriptor for the exact runner binary, build, predicate implementations and typed artifact decoders used by one target revision. A bare runner hash or display label is not executable evidence.
x-qmanSignatureRule: Set manifestDigest and signature to null, encode the complete object with CANONICAL-JSON-V1, store its SHA-256 in manifestDigest, and sign ASCII(QMAN-DIRECTPATH/RUNNER-MANIFEST/V1) || 0x00 || the same bytes with a non-revoked TEST_EVIDENCE key.
x-qmanArtifactRule: The consuming ExecutionEvidenceIndex resolves sourceTreeManifestSha256, build.buildAttestation.sha256, buildLogArtifactSha256, its test-log hash, toolManifestArtifactSha256 and binaryArtifactSha256 to six distinct typed control records with SOURCE_TREE_MANIFEST, BUILD_ATTESTATION, BUILD_LOG, TEST_LOG, TOOL_MANIFEST and RUNNER_BINARY roles. All six hashes and paths are role-exclusive; their on-disk bytes, lengths, media type/schema and SHA-256 are verified, and no one blob or hash may satisfy more than one role.
x-qmanSourceTreeRule: Resolve build.sourceTreeManifestPath inside evidence commit E, verify its raw bytes against sourceTreeManifestSha256, validate it only against contracts/directpath-source-tree-manifest.schema.json whose pinned raw hash equals sourceTreeManifestSchemaSha256, and require its internal sourceTreeSha256 to equal build.sourceTreeSha256. Independently reconstruct the complete tracked-tree projection from this manifest's targetRepositoryCommit C, recursively including submodules with bounded depth/count, and reject any omission, extra path, dirty/untracked build input, unresolved submodule, object-mode/hash mismatch or non-NFC path. runner.path/blobSha256, every predicate evaluator and decoder implementation, and all build recipes resolve at C inside that exact tree.
x-qmanBuildAttestationRule: Resolve build.buildAttestation.path inside evidence commit E; verify exact bytes/length/application-json media type, pinned schemaRef/schemaSha256, internal attestationDigest and TEST_EVIDENCE signature. The parsed BuildAttestation targetRepositoryCommit, mappingCoreId and portableContractSha256 byte-equal this RunnerManifest; consumerKind=RUNNER and consumerBuildId=build.buildId; its SourceTree path/raw hash/schema hash/internal digest projection equals the five corresponding build fields. RunnerManifest accepts only produced HERMETIC_REPRODUCIBLE or PINNED_NONHERMETIC attestation modes; INTERPRETED_NO_BUILD is rejected for a product scenario runner. Its build log, toolchain/dependency/environment closure and produced RUNNER_BINARY output independently derive this manifest's build hashes, reproducibility label and runner.binaryArtifactSha256. HERMETIC_REPRODUCIBLE maps directly; PINNED_NONHERMETIC maps to PINNED_NONHERMETIC_WITH_COMPLETE_MANIFEST. BuildAttestation.attestedAt is strictly before this manifest.createdAt. The attestation is built before and never references this RunnerManifest.
